name: Waterfront Dock (临水码头)
use_for: docks, piers, jetties, boardwalks, fishing platforms, anything touching water

materials.primary_use: decking, always full planks as walking surface
materials.secondary_use: piles driven into the water/ seabed at deck edges (stripped below waterline looks weathered)
materials.accent_use: slab edging strips, fence railing (leave gaps at mooring points), trapdoor dock bumpers on pile tops

roof.type: none (open structure); optional small gable shelter over a bench using spruce_stairs

details.waterline: piles extend 1-2 blocks BELOW water surface to the seabed — never end piles mid-water
details.mooring: barrel + chain + lantern cluster every 4-6 blocks along one edge
details.moss: mossy_cobblestone footing where piles meet water; occasional mossy_cobblestone step down to water
details.lighting: lantern on top of alternating piles, or hanging from chain between two piles
details.steps: spruce_stairs from deck down to a small landing platform at water level

pilaster.note: no walls on a dock — depth comes from piles, trapdoor bumpers and slab edging

string_course.note: slab edging strip along the deck rim plays this role

interview_prompts.rooms: 码头是纯作业平台,还是要带个带顶棚的小休息区/储物角?
structural: 主栈桥做多宽?[3 格/4 格/5 格]
要不要带顶棚的休息区?[要/不要]
要不要下到水面的台阶平台?[要/不要]
栏杆满布还是在系泊点留缺口?[留缺口/满布]
interview_prompts.skip_if: 纯装饰性短栈桥(长度 10 格以内)时,只确认宽度与栏杆做法。
